description: This header defines the 'network_utils' class with static methods for network interface management, ARP table retrieval, VLAN handling, and bridge operations within the 'beerocks::net' namespace. It includes constants, data structures, and function prototypes for network utilities on Linux systems.

classes.name: network_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for network interface management, ARP table access, VLAN configuration, bridge operations, and network statistics on Linux systems.

methods.name: is_valid_mac
methods.description: Checks if a given MAC address string is valid.

methods.name: ipv4_to_string
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address representations to string format.

methods.name: ipv4_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to create an IPv4 address structure.

methods.name: uint_ipv4_from_string
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address string to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: get_ip_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IP addresses assigned to interfaces.

methods.name: get_iface_info
methods.description: Gets detailed info about a network interface.

methods.name: get_raw_iface_info
methods.description: Retrieves raw interface info including MAC and IP addresses.

methods.name: get_arp_table
methods.description: Returns the ARP table as a map of MAC to IP or vice versa.

methods.name: get_mac_from_arp_table
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address associated with an IPv4 from ARP table.

methods.name: linux_get_iface_list
methods.description: Lists all network interfaces on Linux.

methods.name: linux_get_iface_list_from_bridge
methods.description: Lists interfaces attached to a specific bridge.

methods.name: linux_get_iface_state_from_bridge
methods.description: Gets interface state within a bridge.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_host_bridge
methods.description: Finds the bridge hosting a given interface.

methods.name: linux_get_iface_index
methods.description: Gets interface index by name.

methods.name: linux_get_iface_name
methods.description: Gets interface name by index.

methods.name: linux_add_iface_to_bridge
methods.description: Adds an interface to a bridge.

methods.name: linux_remove_iface_from_bridge
methods.description: Removes an interface from a bridge.

methods.name: linux_iface_ctrl
methods.description: Brings interface up or down, optionally assigns IP and netmask.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address of an interface.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_name
methods.description: Finds interface name by MAC address.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_ip
methods.description: Gets IP address of an interface.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_pci_info
methods.description: Retrieves PCI info for an interface.

methods.name: linux_iface_exists
methods.description: Checks if an interface exists.

methods.name: linux_iface_is_up
methods.description: Checks if an interface is up.

methods.name: linux_iface_is_up_and_running
methods.description: Checks if an interface is up and running.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_link_settings
methods.description: Retrieves link speed and duplex info.

methods.name: get_iface_stats
methods.description: Gets network interface statistics.

methods.name: arp_send
methods.description: Sends an ARP packet.

methods.name: icmp_send
methods.description: Sends an ICMP packet.

methods.name: icmp_checksum
methods.description: Calculates ICMP checksum.

methods.name: get_bss_ifaces
methods.description: Lists interfaces belonging to a BSS.

methods.name: build_vlan_interface_name
methods.description: Builds normalized VLAN interface name.

methods.name: create_vlan_interface
methods.description: Creates a VLAN interface.

methods.name: delete_interface
methods.description: Deletes a network interface.

methods.name: set_interface_state
methods.description: Sets interface up or down.

methods.name: set_vlan_filtering
methods.description: Enables or disables VLAN filtering on a bridge.

methods.name: set_iface_vid_policy
methods.description: Sets VLAN ID policy on an interface.

methods.name: set_vlan_packet_filter
methods.description: Adds or removes VLAN packet filter rules.

methods.name: get_eth_sw_mac_from_bridge_mac
methods.description: Generates a locally administered MAC address from a bridge MAC.

methods.name: linux_get_bridges
methods.description: Lists all Linux bridge interfaces.

methods.name: linux_get_ifname_from_port
methods.description: Gets interface name from bridge port number.

methods.name: linux_get_bridge_forwarding_table
methods.description: Retrieves forwarding table entries for a bridge.

methods.name: linux_iface_is_physical
methods.description: Checks if an interface is physical.

methods.name: linux_get_non_physical_bridge_interfaces
methods.description: Lists non-physical bridge member interfaces.

methods.name: linux_get_lan_interfaces
methods.description: Lists LAN interfaces.

methods.name: linux_get_net_dev_stats
methods.description: Reads network device statistics.
